title: Rum Cakes – Mini Bundts
description: A while ago, I received a really nice gift of a mini Bundt cake pan which makes six small cakes. I put that into use this weekend and made the cutest mini rum cakes. I used the Bacardi Golden Rum Cake recipe from about.com but omitted the pecans since I didn’t have them that day and shortened the baking time since they were so small. This recipe is from 1 box of cake mix and makes one regular size (12 cup) Bundt cake or 10-12 mini bundt cakes.
ingredients: 1 (3.4 oz) package instant vanilla pudding mix
1/2 cup coconut rum (Gwen) or Bacardi dark rum
1 cup brown sugar (Blake) or regular sugar
directions: Combine all cake ingredients. Beat for 2 minutes on high with electric mixer. Pour into prepared pan.
Bake for 1 hour. Cool in pan.

Poke holes all over the cake and drizzle the glaze over top of Bacardi Rum Cake while it is still the Bundt pan. (This is what I do different than the original recipe because this way I don’t lose the glaze to the bottom of the cake and keeps the whole cake moister. I let the cake soak up all the glaze for about 30 minutes before inverting it on a platter.)
Remove from heat and stir in rum. Note: The rum will cause steam. Be careful not to burn yourself.
